# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting HackerAI or HackerAI-operated infrastructure to
[security@hackerai.sh](mailto:security@hackerai.sh). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://hackerai.sh/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
